The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

(Published by Authority)Part IV (B) — Local Government

Local Government Notifications

Kolonna PradeshIya Sabha

The roads and lanes which are deem to be owned by kolonna pradeshiya sabha in which are relevant notification is included published in the Gazette No. 2364/39 dated. 31.12.2023 under the terms made by section 24 of pradeshiya sabha act no. 15 of 1987.as the "orders on the preparation of plans and posting of notices showing the list of names of the roads and lanes" maintained by the Pradeshiya sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province as the Honourable Governor of sabaragamuwa Province has publish in the special Gazette No. 2316/20 dated 24 January 2023 and it is hereby published for the public that it has been decided under decision No. 18 of 03rd April 2024 that all said road and lanes shall be owned by kolonna pradeshiya sabha as because of any case has not been assigned in a competent court on the date fixed by the said notification

it is further announced that all roads and lanes included therein shall be deemed to be roads and lanes established by the kolonna pradeshiya sabha under sub section (5) of section 24 of pradeshiya sabha act list of those road and lanes is included in the schedule here P. A. Malika, Secretary and the implementation officer, carrying out the functions, Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha.

Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha,Kolonna,19th.April, 2024.

1A- PG 6713 - 05 (05/2024) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
